claim.claim-text: 1. An integrated circuit for controlling a user device for transmitting and/or receiving data to/from a base station in a communication system, the integrated circuit comprising processing circuitry which, in operation:

receives paging occasion configuration from the base station, including at least one parameter for configuring a predefined time-domain pattern specifying paging occasions within a paging cycle; and performs reception of paging signal in the paging occasions within the predefined time-domain pattern configured according to the received paging occasion configuration.
2. The integrated circuit according to claim 1, wherein:

the predefined time-domain pattern specifies that the paging occasions are only allowed to be present in a regular raster within the paging cycle; and the paging occasion configuration indicates in which raster positions the reception of the paging occasions is to be performed.
3. The integrated circuit according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the paging occasion configuration indicates at least one of

4. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the raster time points are defined in such positions within the paging cycle that the configurable paging occasions do not overlap with synchronization signal blocks.
5. The integrated circuit according to claim 1, wherein:

the predefined time-domain pattern specifies that the paging occasions are to be received in uniformly distributed time intervals within the paging cycle; and the paging occasion configuration indicates the periodicity of the uniformly distributed time intervals.
6. The integrated circuit according to claim 5, wherein the periodicity is specified in the received paging occasion configuration as a number of paging occasions within the paging cycle.

7. The integrated circuit according to claim 5 or 6, wherein the paging occasions are transmitted in a frequency subband which has no overlap with a frequency subband in which synchronization signal blocks are transmitted.

8. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 7, wherein the processing circuitry in operation performs reception of the paging signal in the paging occasions further configured according to a paging occasion calculation specific for the user device and/or a beam-sweeping configuration set in the base station.

9. The integrated circuit according to any of claims 1 to 8, wherein the paging occasion configuration is signaled by the base station within a broadcast channel and includes an offset relatively to a beginning of the paging cycle.
